source:
@@U02895@@
reminding me of the joke I played
on that poor lad some years ago,
confusing his mind with my mock-serious nonsense.
I suspect he’s still gnawing on that bone.
Well, old moth-eaten friend,
I must confess I feel the urge
to wrap myself again in your furry warmth
and play the professor once more,
utterly confident that only he is right.
Academics know how to carry off that farce,
but unfortunately the Devil lost it long ago.
(He shakes the robe he has taken down, and crickets, beetles, and moths
fly out.)

@@U02897@@
We welcome your coming,
Old patron and friend;
With buzzing and humming
On you we attend.
Singly, in silence,
You planted us here,
Swarming by thousands,
To you we appear!
The rogue in the bosom
Hides close in his lair;
Our fur bed we gladly
Forsake for the air.

@@U02899@@
Ah! What a grand surprise!
My youthful creation!
Sow as you will and in time you'll reap.
But let me shake this ragtag robe once more
and see if there’s any left.

@@U02900@@
(He shakes the robe.)
translation:
@@U02895@@
让我想起我玩过的笑话
几年前那个可怜的小伙子，
用我假装严肃的废话来混淆他的思想。
我怀疑他还在啃那根骨头。
嗯，老虫蛀的朋友，
我必须承认我有这种冲动
再次将自己包裹在你毛茸茸的温暖中
再次扮演教授，
完全相信只有他是对的。
学者们知道如何上演这场闹剧，
但不幸的是，魔鬼早已失去了它。
（他抖了抖脱下来的长袍，蟋蟀、甲虫和飞蛾
飞出去。）

@@U02897@@
我们欢迎您的到来，
老赞助人、老朋友；
伴随着嗡嗡声和嗡嗡声
靠你，我们参加。
独自一人，默默地，
你把我们栽种在这里，
成千上万的人蜂拥而至，
我们向你显现！
怀里的流氓
躲在他的巢穴里；
我们很高兴我们的毛皮床
为了空气而放弃。

@@U02899@@
啊！多么大的惊喜啊！
我的青春创作！
只要你愿意播种，迟早你就会收获。
但让我再次抖抖这件破烂的长袍
看看是否还有剩余。

@@U02900@@
（他摇晃长袍。）
